title: Mosaic with spanning tiles
summary: grid-column and grid-row span tiles over several cells; dense packing fills the gaps.
explanation: grid-column: span 2 makes a tile cover two columns; grid-row: span 2 makes it cover two rows. Spanning is how a grid gets a mosaic look without any absolute positioning.

By default the auto-placement cursor only moves forward, so a wide tile that does not fit leaves a hole. grid-auto-flow: dense lets later small tiles fill those holes, at the cost of reordering the visual.
tryThis: Remove grid-auto-flow: dense and watch the gaps appear.
Change .hero to grid-column: span 3 to make it full width.
